The '''Dles system''' contained [[Dles IV]] and was located within the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]].

==History==
The system was first explored centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but the explorers found nothing of value. No permanent [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] were established.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] established several concealed routes to the system and built a penal colony on the planet of Dles IV. Throughout the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] several [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] beacons monitored any traffic.
